title: Very underwhelmed
text: Mine sounds better than a few people, but I did only get 6 treats, and 3 of them were very tiny and skinny tendons, so didn't take them long to work through them. There was also a trachea tube, a 5"pizzle , and a longer braided pizzle (Iam staving that for a trip for the puppy).  I have 8 dogs, and ordered the large/ medium breed box, expecting to get something like what they showed in the photos. Nope. Large box, very empty, good thing it was half price for the first month, I did right away cancel. I planned to weigh the treats to give a better idea of weight, but handed out treats instead to a few lucky recipients. I did get photos though, and will post them later.
label: negative
